description_en: Drunk Baker (nicknamed "醉师傅" by customers) is a Shanghai bakery chain run by Shanghai Zuichou Enterprise Management Co., Ltd (上海醉丑企业管理有限公司). WeChat official account: DRUNK BAKER; WeChat mini-program: DRUNK BAKER mini (location may fail to resolve, and the mini-program may be unusable, outside mainland China); Xiaohongshu accounts: DRUNK BAKER, DRUNK BAKER顾客服务中心. It has 44 locations across Shanghai (Xuhui, Minhang, Jing'an, Changning, Huangpu, Pudong, Hongkou, Yangpu, Baoshan, Jiading, Songjiang, Fengxian, Jinshan, and Putuo districts) — see the Chinese description for the full branch list with exact addresses, nearest metro exit, and hours (real addresses are kept in Chinese since that's the practical format for routing in Shanghai). Menu: cakes (mostly long/shareable loaf-style, 38-48rmb) — sour cream banana pound cake (signature), nine-layer waxberry blueberry cake, strawberry salted feta cake, matcha jasmine cake, tiramisu dark chocolate brownie, earl grey chocolate Basque cheesecake, lemon cake. Baguettes (18-24rmb): matcha chocolate, pistachio cheese, raisin cheese. Flattened croissants (~18rmb): matcha longjing, nine-layer matcha, comté cheese. Fresh toast (~28rmb): salted cheese sea-salt butter toast, salted cheese toast.

菜单与价格：
蛋糕（大部分是长条形的，可以分享，一般38-48rmb）：酸奶油香蕉磅蛋糕（招牌蛋糕）、九层杨梅蓝莓蛋糕、草莓咸法酪蛋糕、抹茶茉莉八重奏蛋糕、提拉米苏黑巧布朗尼、伯爵红茶生巧巴斯克、柠檬蛋糕。
法棍（18-24rmb）：生巧抹茶法棍、开心果奶酪法棍、提子奶酪法棍。
压扁可颂（一般18rmb）：抹茶龙井压扁可颂、九层抹茶压扁可颂、孔泰奶酪压扁可颂。
生吐司（一般28rmb）：大块咸奶酪海盐黄油生吐司、大块咸奶酪吐司。
